html:
Unique Research · Event · April 15, 2024

Foundation models and generative AI are deepening digital-intelligent transformation across industries, with strong AI applications emerging in China and abroad. To map the latest China AIGC industry dynamics, Unique Research invites you to join the open call for the 2024 China AIGC Industry Map 4.0.

The map will present representative companies and the industry chain in China’s AIGC space. We hope leading domestic enterprises and institutions take part and help Unique Research draw a fuller picture of the China AIGC industry.

As a participant, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Showcase your company’s or project’s technical strength and innovation outcomes in AIGC.

History of the China AIGC Industry Map

1.0 — On February 21, 2023, Unique Research published China’s first AIGC industry map 1.0, organized mainly by modality (text, audio, video, image, etc.), covering dozens of companies when the domestic AIGC industry was still early.

2.0 — On April 26, 2023, Unique Research updated to 2.0, structuring the AIGC chain into foundation, model, and application layers, and including both foundation models and AIGC apps. Boundaries between models and apps kept blurring: model vendors shipped their own apps; application players raised algorithm capability and began training vertical models.

3.0 — On September 6, 2023, Unique Research shipped 3.0 with richer application-layer categories. Domestic AIGC apps were proliferating — C-end and B-end, horizontal and vertical. We tried to draw a picture closer to then-current and future industry reality.

4.0 — On April 15, 2024, we announce the forthcoming 4.0 update. First, B-end and C-end application ecosystems are richer — emotional companionship, productivity tools, knowledge bases, workflow automation, and more. Second, AIGC go-global products have opened markets in multiple countries and regions with solid results. Third, with open-source and developer ecosystems, many companies are advancing in AI Agent and Infra. We will substantially expand map coverage and company count.

Submission details

1. Who can apply

Companies providing relevant foundation-model or AIGC products/services for China or overseas markets. AI2B apps need at least 5 enterprise customers; AI2C apps need at least 100,000 monthly visits.

2. Map structure

  • Infrastructure — AI underlying hardware infrastructure such as networking equipment and software vendors.
  • Foundation models (general & vertical) — single- or multimodal general and vertical models supporting text-to-text, text-to-image, text-to-video, and related forms.
  • Middle layer — middleware including AI infra and AI Agents.
  • Horizontal applications — general AI apps for C-end consumers and/or B-end enterprises (non-exhaustive).
  • Vertical applications — AI verticals for specific industries including but not limited to retail, FMCG, education, healthcare, finance, and industry.

3. Process

Call window: April 15 – April 30.

Publication: AIGC vendors that submit and pass Unique Research review will be listed in the 2024 China AIGC Industry Map 4.0. The formal map is expected mid-to-late May, with full-matrix media distribution. Unique Research holds final interpretation rights for this call and the map.

Special note

This map call charges no fee. Materials submitted by enterprises will be kept strictly confidential by Unique Research.

Submission channel

The original Chinese post ended with a “submission channel” heading (image/QR block); no registration URL was present in the extracted text — do not invent one. Refer to the CN article for the live channel.

— END —
